text: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 Overdosage Experience The most commonly reported signs and symptoms associated with Clozapine ODT overdose are: sedation, delirium, coma, tachycardia, hypotension, respiratory depression or failure; and hypersalivation. There are reports of aspiration pneumonia, cardiac arrhythmias, and seizure. Fatal overdoses have been reported with clozapine, generally at doses above 2500 mg. There have also been reports of patients recovering from overdoses well in excess of 4 g. 10.2 Management of Overdosage There are no specific antidotes for Clozapine ODT overdose. Establish and maintain an airway; ensure adequate oxygenation and ventilation. Monitor cardiac status and vital signs. Use general symptomatic and supportive measures. Consider the possibility of multiple-drug involvement. Contact a Certified Poison Control Center for the most up to date information on the management of overdosage (1-800-222-1222).
